title: X (Twitter): Sign In With X and Post From Workflows | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors who have an X account can sign in to your site with it, and your site can post to X by itself when content is published. Both need the keys of an X app and a few settings.

The X (Twitter) module has two features. Sign in with X (Twitter) adds a button to the login page, and X (Twitter) Integration stores the keys of the app and, when Workflows is enabled, adds a workflow task that posts to X. This video enables them, enters fake keys, and builds a workflow that sends a post when a Blog Post is published.

In this video:
• What the module provides
• Enable the features
• Enter the keys of your X app
• Set up Sign in with X
• The login page
• The first sign-in
• Post from a workflow
